The data arrays are lengthy, but that's configuration rather than rendering code. - `PricingFAQ.tsx` is 432 lines, but most of that is FAQ data structure. Looking at the system prompt's criteria about flagging files that render 4+ visually distinct page sections inline, `Navbar.tsx` really just renders the desktop navigation with flyouts and the mobile menu—two contexts of the same component rather than separate sections. I don't think these files actually cross that threshold. 3. **Copy-pasted JSX (Category 3)**: - In `Navbar.tsx`: The four flyout navigation items (Products, Solutions, Resources, Enterprise) are each coded individually with the same structure: a wrapper div with mouse event handlers, a trigger button, and a panel div. This pattern repeats across lines 291–403 and should be extracted into a reusable subcomponent that gets mapped over instead. ` elements, so there's definitely room to consolidate this into a reusable component that accepts the flyout name, label, content type, and width as props. I'm identifying the specific locations of these copy-paste issues: the desktop flyout sections starting around line 291 and the mobile accordion sections starting at line 474, where each nav category repeats the same structural pattern instead of using a shared component with mapped data. The mobile menu does have some variation in which items get merged together, but the underlying JSX structure is still duplicated across all four sections.
